description: Lists the anomaly cases of a Monatsreporting run: view summary (default) gives counts, sums and top cases, view cases lists single cases, filtered and paginated. status: open (default), decided (resolved/dismissed) or all. by_cost_center entries carry hidden (hidden in the app) and are never dropped. Amounts (actual, reference, delta = actual - reference, delta_pct) are taken unchanged from the detection rules; only budget_deviation and mom_outlier carry delta (sign_flip: actual = current, duplicate_suspicion: actual = amount, missing_account: no amount). sum_abs_delta is per kind, never mixed across kinds (null plus cases_without_delta for kinds without delta). commentary is the case note (Reporting-Vermerk): material for the comment of the position while the case is open, the short form of that comment once a person accepts it in the app. The report shows comments (list-comment-status), not case notes. commentary_source: ai = AI review, user = a person, null = older case. A follow_up case checks an earlier watch item: watch holds the original statement and the result (recurred true/false/null; position_missing true = position not assessable this month, which is not "did not recur"). Each case carries clarification (open or answered question with context, suggestions, answer) or null; the summary counts open_clarifications and follow_ups. updated_at is the last change of the case, not the decision time.

after_id.description: view cases: cursor, the next_cursor of the previous page

category.description: Filter by P&L category, name as shown in the app. An ambiguous name is rejected; pnl_label_id then identifies the category.

limit.description: view cases: page size (default 50, silently capped at 200)

min_abs_delta.description: Only cases with abs(delta) at least this amount (cases without delta are excluded)

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

pnl_label_id.description: Filter by P&L category id (UUID); use when the category name is ambiguous

status.description: open (default): unresolved cases; decided: resolved + dismissed; all: both

top.description: view summary: number of top cases (default 20, max 50)

view.description: summary (default): counts, sums and top cases; cases: single cases, paginated

name: list-open-anomaly-cases
